subject: website
name: D2 Playground on Swarm
summary: The D2 diagram playground served from Swarm: a modified build of the public D2 playground (MPL-2.0) that adds a Share via Swarm button. No public source for this build, with its Swarm additions, was found, so it stays at Level 2. When it opens it runs no third-party code and makes no request; diagrams compile in WebAssembly in the page. Share via Swarm uploads to the bzz.limo gateway and the TALA layout calls api.d2lang.com, both only when the user starts them.

connections.name: Swarm gateway (bzz.limo)
connections.note: Only when the user presses Share via Swarm or opens a shared link.

connections.name: D2 render API (api.d2lang.com)
connections.note: Only when the user picks the TALA layout.
